You noticed that the squares were of different sizes, but I wonder how these sizes were determined? Many of you wondered why some companies did not have stock market values. You had some catchy headlines including TN of Chelsea’s “What Does a Trillion Mean?” and Jane of Milwaukee’s “Business By the Billions.” Good noticing and wondering leads to snappy headlines.

	What do you WONDER? What are you curious about?

	What’s GOING ON in this graph?

Then, read some responses. Click on "Reply" to an interesting response to get a discussion going. Learn different perspectives when you read what other students have to say about your response. 

We look forward to reading your discoveries.
